067-02.b1.b1.d1.d2.b2_agitated-chop-fall.sentence: A trader holds the agitated-chop short on monthly losers for about ten days, sized by the depth of the month's fall.

038-01.g2_scaled-rally-continues-calm-up.sentence: In a rising, calm market, a coin keeps rising over the next 3 days, more so the larger its 3-day return measured in units of the standard deviation of its daily returns over the last 30 days.

048-01_falling-agitated-wide-rise-giveba.sentence: In a falling, agitated market, the larger a day's rise against the coin's 30-day daily swing, multiplied by how wide that day's high-to-low range is against its 30-day usual range, the larger the coin's fall over the next day.

077-01.b1.b1.g1_choppy-calm-swing-fall-c.sentence: In a choppy, calm market, a coin whose 14-day return is negative against its own daily swing over the past 30 days keeps falling over the next 7 days, and the larger that swing-scaled fall, the larger the further fall.

047-01.g1_agitated-wide-up-day-next-day-.sentence: In a falling, agitated market, on a day a coin closes higher, the wider that day's high-to-low range against the coin's usual daily range, the larger its fall over the next day.

065-01.b1_slide-ending-sharp-day-rebound.sentence: In an agitated downtrend, a trader buys the rebound after a slide that ends in a sharp down day, and skips slides that end in a quiet day.

067-01.b1.g1.b1.d1.d2.g1_choppy-calm-mon.sentence: In a choppy, calm market, the larger a coin's 30-day return is in either direction, the further it moves the same way over the next 10 days, so that a stronger month rise is followed by a larger rise and a deeper month fall by a larger fall.

058-02.b1.b1.g2_calm-uptrend-dip-three-d.sentence: In a rising, calm market, the larger a coin's one-day fall against its usual daily swing over the past 30 days, the larger its rise over the next 3 days.

061-01.d1.d1_rising-calm-big-day-follow-.sentence: Buy calm up days in proportion to their size in swing units only while the coin's 60-day trend is up, and stay flat in falling calm markets, where the deepest falls of the long book came from.

058-01.g2.g1.d1.d1.b1_deep-fall-bounce-a.sentence: In a falling, agitated market, a coin's up day that comes after a 3-day fall is followed by a fall over the next day, and the deeper that 3-day fall against the standard deviation of its daily returns over the past 30 days, the larger the next-day fall.

041-01.g1_wide-down-day-range-bounce.sentence: A wide down day in a falling, agitated coin is a reason to buy for one day, and the wider the day, the larger the bounce to expect.

067-02.b1.b1.b1.b1.g2_choppy-calm-upside.sentence: In a quiet, range-bound coin, a close well above its 20-day average is a reason to hold long for about ten days rather than sell the range top.

033-02.d1_high-close-fades-in-selloffs.sentence: Consequence: A close pinned near the high during an agitated decline is a short for the next day, while the same close in a rising market is no reason to sell.

061-01.g1.d1.d2.d2.g2_choppy-calm-day-fo.sentence: The larger a coin's one-day move against the standard deviation of its daily returns over the past 30 days, the further the coin keeps moving the same way over the next 5 days, wherever the close sits against its recent highs.

063-02_agitated-5day-drop-bounce-fade.sentence: The larger the fall of its 5-day return up to the day before the bounce against its 30-day swing of daily returns, the larger the coin's fall over the next day.

078-01_choppy-agitated-wide-rally-fade.sentence: In a choppy, agitated market, an up day whose high-to-low range is wide against the coin's average daily range over the past 20 days is followed by a fall over the next day, and the wider that day's range against its 20-day average, the larger the fall.

032-01.b1_monthly-low-exhaustion-rebound.sentence: In a falling, agitated market, when a coin closes below the lowest close of its previous 30 days, it rebounds over the next 7 days, and the further the close sits below that prior 30-day low, the larger the rebound.

058-02.b1.b2.b1.b2.b2.e1.g1_choppy-calm-.sentence: In a choppy, calm market, the nearer a coin's close sits to the top of its 20-day high-low range, the larger its rise over the next 10 days, and the nearer to the bottom, the larger its fall.

058-01.g2.g1.g1.d1.d1.d1_deep-rejected-r.sentence: In a falling, agitated market, the first up day after a down day is followed by a fall over the next day only when the rally was sold off well below its high.

041-02.g1_agitated-fall-down-day-range-b.sentence: the larger a coin's one-day fall against its 30-day average daily range, the larger its rise over the next day.

064-01_falling-calm-up-day-fades.sentence: In a falling, calm market, the larger a coin's one-day rise measured in units of its own 30-day standard deviation of daily returns, the larger the fall in its close over the next 3 days.

077-03.d1.b1.b1_wide-high-close-next-day.sentence: The idea states: "In a choppy, agitated market, a day that closes near its high on a range wide against the coin's 30-day swing is followed by a fall over the next day.

058-03.g1.g1_calm-downtrend-weekly-fall-.sentence: In a falling, calm market, a coin that has fallen over its last 5 days keeps falling over the next 5 days, and the further it has fallen over those 5 days, the more it falls next, whatever the volume of the fall.

034-01.b1.g1_calm-rising-nearness-drift.sentence: A trader would ride closes near or above the 20-day high for about ten days when the coin's recent swing is no larger than usual, and lean less on them when it is agitated.

033-01.d2_falling-agitated-fall-rebound.sentence: A trader buys outsized one-day falls mainly when the coin has been falling for weeks and swinging hard, where forced selling is heaviest and the rebound largest.

074-01_falling-calm-month-rise-continues.sentence: In a falling, calm market, a coin whose 30-day return is positive keeps rising over the next 10 days, and the larger that 30-day rise is against the standard deviation of its daily returns over the same 30 days, the larger the rise that follows.

033-01.g1_calm-uptrend-dip-rebound.sentence: In a rising, calm market, a down day is followed by a rise over the next 3 days, and the rise is larger the more that day's fall exceeds the coin's usual daily swing (the standard deviation of its daily returns over the past 30 days).

061-01.d2.b1_rising-calm-continuation-mo.sentence: An outsized up day in a calm, rising coin is a reason to buy for the next five days, more so the larger the day, since this is where the continuation is strongest.

032-02.b1.b1.b1_agitated-choppy-break-re.sentence: In a choppy, agitated market, when a coin's daily close is below the lowest low of its prior 20 days, its price rises over the next day, and the further the close sits below that low, the larger the rise.

058-01.g2.g1.d1.d2.b1_wide-bounce-fade-a.sentence: In a falling, agitated market, a coin's up day that comes while its 3-day return is still negative is followed by a fall over the next day, and the wider that day's high-to-low range against the standard deviation of its daily returns over the past 30 days, the larger the next-day fall.
